label_vocabulary.eligibility: Google states a condition for a feature to be eligible; eligibility is not a guarantee of display.

label_vocabulary.note: These labels describe Google's own guidance. They are separate from this toolkit's configurable specialist heuristics, which are never presented as Google requirements.

JavaScript rendering, canonical, notranslate and encoded-URL-space guidance qualified without changing runtime severities.
